title: Quadratic equation from indexed terms
statement: Let $N$ be a natural number, let $T$ be a finite list of ordered pairs $(i,j)$ with $i,j\in\{0,\ldots,N-1\}$, and let $b\in\mathbb{F}_2$. The associated homogeneous quadratic equation over $\mathbb{F}_2$ in $N$ variables has right-hand side $b$ and coefficient matrix obtained by summing, with multiplicity, the matrices that have a $1$ in position $(i,j)$ and zeros elsewhere for each pair $(i,j)$ in $T$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite list of ordered pairs of indices in $\{0,\ldots,N-1\}$
